mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month indicates a weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate revenues and thus leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals labor market weakness, which is a leading indicator of economic downturn and thus leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the periods analyzed, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals easing inflationary pressures, which is typically followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.
